channel.title: cg-alert public change feed
channel.description: Live capture of vendor-facing changes: pricing shifts, legal/DPA updates, security/incident status, and evidence snapshots. Daily ops health + 7-day diagnostics + per-vendor proof bundles. This feed exists so buyers, audit, and procurement can prove "what changed, when".

item.title: Vendor Evidence Snapshot · 2025-10
item.description: Full capture for 2025-10 across vendors (Adyen, Algolia, Atlassian, AWS, Box, Cloudflare, Datadog, Snowflake, Stripe, etc). Includes Pricing/*, DPA/*, Privacy/*, Security/*, Status/*, Subprocessors/*, ToS/*.

item.title: Adyen evidence bundle · DPA / Pricing / Security / Status
item.description: Timestamped HTML snapshots for adyen.com (DPA, Pricing, Privacy, Security, Subprocessors, Status, ToS) including multiple same-day captures like 2025-10-13 and 2025-10-17 for diffable audit trail.

item.title: Ops Daily Check · 2025-10-18
item.description: Daily ops surface for 2025-10-18: system state, crawl status, intake pipeline sanity, outbound proof generation, and alertability.

item.title: 7-Day Diagnostic Window
item.description: Aggregated 7-day ops diagnostics (crawl coverage, diff generation, evidence tagging, public publish health). Meant for buyers who want to confirm this feed is alive, not screenshots from last quarter.
